fields.description: Bay Estate is Nakheel's gated coastal community at Dubai Islands. Its Verda, Cala and Agora neighbourhoods combine family homes with landscaped public spaces and waterfront facilities. The residential offering includes three- and four-bedroom townhouses, four-bedroom villas and a separate selection of villa plots.

overview: Verda centres on gardens and family living, Cala on the shoreline, and Agora on shared community experiences. The attached-villa Plus adds another level for flexible family use. Compare the actual arrangement of rooms and outside space rather than treating each four-bedroom format as interchangeable.

The floor-plan disclaimer excludes swimming pools and landscaping from the supplied home. Rendered gardens, furnishings and views are illustrative; the purchase agreement should identify the selected home's specification and the owner's additional works.
research.locationNote: Bay Estate forms part of Dubai Islands off the Deira coastline. The developer describes a private gated estate with pedestrian routes and water-related facilities. A coastal masterplan does not establish that every home is beachfront or has the same marina, beach or lagoon access.
research.priceNote: Official average home prices in AED: three-bedroom townhouse 5.9m; four-bedroom townhouse 6.9m; attached villa 7.2m; Plus 8.9m; garden villa 10m. These are averages, not available unit offers. The separate villa-plot range is AED 16.5m–20.5m.
research.paymentNote: The schedule below applies to homes. Plots instead require 20% in October 2026, 15% in March 2027, then 13% each September 2027, March 2028, September 2028, March 2029 and September 2029. Fees and subsequent villa construction are separate.
research.handoverNote: The official sheet estimates homes completion in January 2031. September 2029 is the last plot instalment date; it does not establish delivery of a completed villa.

facts.label: Initial launch and wider estate
facts.value: Nakheel's announcement identifies approximately 360 three/four-bedroom homes plus plots in the launch. Its wider masterplan spans 653,709 sq m with2.4km of beachfront and 6.5km of waterfront; these are estate-level figures.

facts.label: What the price-sheet areas mean
facts.value: Average NSA is separate from plot area and the individual drawings' total areas. For example, the garden-villa sheet quotes average 5,200 sq ft NSA and 6,500 sq ft plot; the own drawing prints5,200.15 sq ft total area.

facts.label: Villa plots
facts.value: The separate plot page quotes average 8,000 sq ft plot area and 7,800 sq ft GFA. This is a land-and-permitted-floor-area reference, not an included completed villa.

facts.label: Private pool and landscape exclusion
facts.value: The residence drawings explicitly exclude swimming pools and landscape features, assigning these to the end user. Confirm design approvals and the additional construction/maintenance budget.

unresolved: Confirm current unit/plot availability, exact frontage, registered area, plot boundaries and final pricing; published averages are not live offers.
Home NSA, floor-plan total area, plot area and permitted GFA are different measures; confirm the selected property's contractual area schedule.
The plot sheet does not establish completed-villa delivery. Confirm plot controls, approvals, construction obligations and infrastructure handover.

Service charges, parking allocation, final specification, amenity access and delivery dates require unit-specific documents. Private pools and landscaping are excluded from the reviewed residence plans. Images remain illustrative.
